messages:
maria: Heads up — during the new llama-variant AWQ bring-up on staging we saw a reproducible drift after ~120s of sustained traffic when act-quant is enabled. Outputs start repeating tokens and some answers degrade on factual QA.
sam: Is this the cold-start warmup issue or something else? any logs?
maria: Looks like cold-start-ish: first minute fine, then error rate climbs. paste of the failing tail from runtime logs:
```
[2026-03-15T18:17:32Z] batcher: group_size=64 selected
[2026-03-15T18:19:34Z] runner: kv_cache_miss spike, latency +120ms
[2026-03-15T18:19:35Z] actq: group_permuted=true
[2026-03-15T18:19:36Z] sample: repeated-token-streak=9
```
sam: Hmm. group_size=64 is aggressive for this model's activation distribution. Did you try falling back to smaller groups or disabling act quant?
maria: Quick experiments:
- group_size=64, actq=on: QA exact match drops from 82% -> 68% after 2 mins
- group_size=32, actq=on: drops to 76%
- group_size=16, actq=on: stable ~81% but throughput drops 18%
- group_size=64, actq=off: stable ~82% but cost ↑20%
(devon: thanks for the numbers)
devon: That pattern suggests act-quant accumulation error over long sequences. Could be prefix cache interplay + quant scaling drift. Any correlations with batch size or prefix caching TTL?
maria: Observed correlation with long prefixes — sessions with >1024 tokens show earlier degradation.
infra-bot: Deploy note: canary 3 -> 4 showed same regression; autoscaler didn't trigger.
sam: Two immediate hypotheses:
1) act quant calibration uses running statistics that diverge across batches when group_size is large
2) KV cache reuse + quantized activations lose precision causing token repetition
maria: Proposed next steps:
- Run isolated fixed-seed runs with streaming disabled to reproduce without batching.
- Try per-layer act quant calibration (reset stats at model load) vs global running stats.
- Add K-sparsity check: instrument top-k activation magnitudes per layer over time.
- If repro stable, wire a canary policy to force actq=off for sessions > 512 prefix len.
sam: Also add a metric alert: token-repeat-rate > 5% over 30s. QA to run the 1k QA prompt set every 5 mins to catch regressions.
qa-bot: Scheduled eval job: awq-actq-stability-check v1 queued — will run 1k QA, 500 chat threads, and synthetic long-prefix sequences.
devon: If per-layer reset fixes it, we should consider forcing stats reset on rollout or a warmup run that re-calibrates actq per model instance.
maria: I'll run the isolated experiments now and post the raw traces. If anyone wants to join, ping me @maria — will dump CSVs and a short plotting notebook.
sam: Thanks. If we confirm, we should add a runtime fallback to disable actq automatically when repeat-rate crosses threshold to avoid user impact. :thumbsup:
maria: Agree. I'll land the canary config and the alert PR after experiments.
